scope: One64coordinate synthetic complete constant-step integer grid, all index/value/type/order/global/unknownmetadata preserved; two fresh same narrow-base-profile no-tool native input+output totals. No profile-effect attribution, rawformatting, scientific validity, retrieval/fanout, long-horizon/statistical/cash/development net savings.

implementation.procedure: Inspect actual whole strictJSON arithmetic encoder/ordered current-source decoder/CLI and complete fallback.
implementation.acceptance: At least3 different signed-bound integers exact nonzero constantstep; all fields/indexes/types/order retained, original bytes unchanged.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent exact expansion/oracle and negative tests including limits/sourceSHA/frame/type/order tampering.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Bound count<=50000 before allocation, start/step/end signed bound; invalid/unknown/stale/duplicate/nonfinite/surrogate/path/symlink/bytes/output fails, unsupported sequences fullfallback.

data_integrity.procedure: Freeze actual import closure/fixtures/config/profile/schema/settings; compare original/private/redacted native controls.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly2fresh quota<90calls no retries/tools/reroute; same current human/project injections retained and no production-profile claim.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute actual input/output/reasoning/cache/total/pairspend from original native events.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: baseline_total>candidate_total; include output/reasoning, cache not subtracted, no estimated/cash/crossfixture profile saving.

measurement_validity.procedure: Same question/schema/model/high-effort/narrowbase/settings/catalog/non-task plaintext; exact full source values both arms.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Only exact grid representation differs, no field selection, fake source normalization or omitted dependencies/recovery inference.

reproducibility.procedure: Actual separate reviewer checks sourcebound complete expansion, oracle/rawcontrol bindings and negative tests.
reproducibility.acceptance: Current manualnotEngine usable-with-scope, no unobserved workflow/existence/scientific/net-development claims.
